say:0:1321001001:0.text: Oh, isn't that Mister Teapot and the Flower Attendant? Are they having an argument over there?
say:0:1321001001:0.source_cn: 咦，是茶壶先生和奇花侍者。他们在吵什么呢？

say:2:1321003001:1.text: Tell me, how hard is it to manage the art supplies? It's such a simple job, yet you still keep messing it up!
say:2:1321003001:1.source_cn: 管理画具如此简单的一件小事，为什么你还能出这么多差错？

say:3:1321003002:1.text: It is our duty to pay attention to His Lordship's preferences and habits at all times! For example, he always reaches for brushes on his right while painting, so why did you put the brush stand on the left?
say:3:1321003002:1.source_cn: 想服侍好子爵先生，必须时刻注意他的喜好与习惯！先生作画...

say:4:1321003003:1.text: As His Lordship's longest-serving attendant, I handle far more tasks than you, and they're much more complicated. Yet, I've never made such careless mistakes. You could really learn a thing or two from me!
say:4:1321003003:1.source_cn: 作为陪伴子爵先生最久的仆人，我每天要做的事比你更多更繁...

say:5:1321003004:1.text: But didn't you also buy tea His Lordship hates last time? We had to serve it to Miss Valka and those guests just to get rid of it...
say:5:1321003004:1.source_cn: 可是，您上次也买到了子爵先生讨厌的茶叶。为了消耗它们，...

say:8:1321003005:1.text: Wait a second... Those guests weren't us, were they?
say:8:1321003005:1.source_cn: 等一下！你们说的那些贵客不会就是我们吧？！

say:9:1321003006:1.text: *Gasp* Oh my, since when did you arrive? Excuse me for the poor hospitality! Please don't let what he said bother you!
say:9:1321003006:1.source_cn: 客……客人！您怎么突然来了，是我招待不周……哎呀，请别...

say:12:1321003007:1.text:
But I'm just telling the truth...
You always sneak off to slack whenever His Lordship steps out... I've seen it with my own eyes.
say:12:1321003007:1.source_cn: ……我说的都是真的。\n子爵先生外出取材时，您也常常躲...

say:13:1321003008:1.text: W-who said I was slacking?! I-I was working on perfecting my tea-brewing technique!
say:13:1321003008:1.source_cn: 谁……谁告诉你我是去偷懒了？！我明明是在钻研如何泡一壶好茶！

say:14:1321003009:1.text: Hmph, even if my work is occasionally less than flawless, at least I don't lose or damage His Lordship's art supplies like you. Do you have any idea how important the right tools are to an artist?
say:14:1321003009:1.source_cn: 咳，即使我的工作偶尔做得不够尽善尽美，却也不会像你那样...

say:15:1321003010:1.text: And don't get me started on the countless times you've failed to clean the brush holder or restock white paint on time.
say:15:1321003010:1.source_cn: 至于没有定期清洗笔筒、及时补上白色的颜料之类的小纰漏，...

say:16:1321003011:1.text: I—I haven't made such mistakes recently!
say:16:1321003011:1.source_cn: 我、我最近没犯过这种错！

say:17:1321003012:1.text: Do I need to remind you about His Lordship's favorite tea set you broke last month?
say:17:1321003012:1.source_cn: 而且，你上个月也打碎了子爵先生最珍爱的那套茶具啊……

say:18:1321003013:1.text: I-I was trying to... Argh! Forget it!

say:19:1321003014:1.text: In any case, a careless attendant like you is hardly fit to serve His Lordship properly. From now on, it's better if I handle all the important tasks.
say:19:1321003014:1.source_cn: 总之，像你这么粗心的侍从，是很难服侍好子爵先生的。以后...

say:20:1321003015:1.text: That's not fair! I didn't do anything wrong...!
say:20:1321003015:1.source_cn: 不……不行，我又没做错什么……！

choice_prompt:21:1321003015.text: That's not fair! I didn't do anything wrong...!
choice_prompt:21:1321003015.source_cn: 不……不行，我又没做错什么……！

say:22:1321003016:1.text: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.
say:22:1321003016:1.source_cn: 不不不，尊敬的客人，这可不是一件小事。
say:22:1321003016:1.male: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.
say:22:1321003016:1.female: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.

say:23:1321003018:1.text: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.
say:23:1321003018:1.source_cn: 这样吧。为了不打扰子爵先生的休息，在下有个不情之请。
say:23:1321003018:1.male: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.
say:23:1321003018:1.female: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.

say:24:1321003019:1.text: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?
say:24:1321003019:1.male: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?
say:24:1321003019:1.female: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?

say:25:1321003020:1.text: What do you say, Mister Flower?

say:28:1321003022:1.text: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?
say:28:1321003022:1.source_cn: 作为侍从，最重要的不就是有用吗……？
say:28:1321003022:1.male: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?
say:28:1321003022:1.female: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?

say:32:1321003025:1.text: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.
say:32:1321003025:1.source_cn: 不论如何，请您先体验一下我的工作吧。这边请。
say:32:1321003025:1.male: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.
say:32:1321003025:1.female: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.

choice:27:0:1.text: Must usefulness be the only standard?
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 一定要以有用没用作为标准吗？
choice:27:0:1.male: Must usefulness be the only standard?
choice:27:0:1.female: Must usefulness be the only standard?

say:34:1321003023:1.text: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.
say:34:1321003023:1.source_cn: 您说笑了。如果我是一盏没用的茶壶，那么早该碎成碎片了。
say:34:1321003023:1.male: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.
say:34:1321003023:1.female: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.

choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 也许创造你们不是因为“有用”？

choice:21:0:1.text: Don't fight over something so trivial!
choice:21:0:1.male: Don't fight over something so trivial!
choice:21:0:1.female: Don't fight over something so trivial!

say:35:1321003017:1.text: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.
say:35:1321003017:1.source_cn: 噢，那可不行。客人，请您原谅我的失礼。
say:35:1321003017:1.male: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.
say:35:1321003017:1.female: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.

choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 再吵下去，柳博米尔就要听到了

say:0:1321004001:0.text: This is where I prepare tea every day.
say:0:1321004001:0.source_cn: 正是这里，我每日泡茶的地方。

say:1:1321004002:0.text: The easiest task is<style="highlight"> arranging the tea sets</style>. Please give it a try.
say:1:1321004002:0.source_cn: 最简单的工作是<style=highlight>整理茶...
say:1:1321004002:0.male: The easiest task is<style="highlight"> arranging the tea sets</style>. Please give it a try.
say:1:1321004002:0.female: The easiest task is<style="highlight"> arranging the tea sets</style>. Please give it a try.

say:3:1321005001:1.text: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!
say:3:1321005001:1.source_cn: 不愧是子爵先生的客人！收纳得既迅速又整齐！
say:3:1321005001:1.male: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!
say:3:1321005001:1.female: You've done a fantastic job—His Lordship would definitely approve of your skills!

say:4:1321005002:1.text: But of course, my work involves far more than just arranging tea sets. The process of preparing and brewing tea is an art in itself.
say:4:1321005002:1.source_cn: 当然，我每日的工作不仅仅是整理茶具这么简单。准备茶具、...
say:4:1321005002:1.male: But of course, my work involves far more than just arranging tea sets. The process of preparing and brewing tea is an art in itself.
say:4:1321005002:1.female: But of course, my work involves far more than just arranging tea sets. The process of preparing and brewing tea is an art in itself.

say:5:1321005003:1.text: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.
say:5:1321005003:1.source_cn: 先是预热，然后投、洗、冲、泡、分茶，每一步都格外关键。
say:5:1321005003:1.male: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.
say:5:1321005003:1.female: Preheating, measuring, rinsing, steeping, and pouring—every single step matters.

say:6:1321005004:1.text: That sounds so complicated... You must be incredibly skilled!
say:6:1321005004:1.source_cn: 哇，听起来好复杂……你一定很专业！

say:7:1321005005:1.text: Thank you for the kind words. Besides tending to the tea, I'm also responsible for keeping the manor immaculate—though the naturally weathered ruins are left as they are. His Lordship has always appreciated the beauty of time's touch.
say:7:1321005005:1.source_cn: 多谢您的夸奖。除去茶具相关的工作，我也要保证庄园内的整...

say:8:1321005006:1.text: Looks like you take on so much work here. You must be pretty busy.
say:8:1321005006:1.source_cn: 你确实负责了庄园内的不少工作呢，平时肯定很忙吧。

say:9:1321005007:2.text: As His Lordship's most trusted creation, I take great pride in dedicating myself to these duties.
say:9:1321005007:2.source_cn: 作为最熟悉子爵先生喜好的造物，自然该多用心。

say:10:1321005008:1.text: After all, I am his favorite teapot—it's my duty to ensure everything is flawless.
say:10:1321005008:1.source_cn: 我陪伴先生多年，又是先生生前最喜爱的茶具。哪里有人比我...

choice_prompt:11:1321005008.text: After all, I am his favorite teapot—it's my duty to ensure everything is flawless.
choice_prompt:11:1321005008.source_cn: 我陪伴先生多年，又是先生生前最喜爱的茶具。哪里有人比我更该为这一切负责呢？

say:12:1321005009:1.text: Oh, absolutely not. It would improper to ask a guest to brew tea. Please leave the rest to me.
say:12:1321005009:1.source_cn: 不，剩下的由我来完成就好。让客人亲自泡茶未免太失礼了。
say:12:1321005009:1.male: Oh, absolutely not. It would improper to ask a guest to brew tea. Please leave the rest to me.
say:12:1321005009:1.female: Oh, absolutely not. It would improper to ask a guest to brew tea. Please leave the rest to me.

say:13:1321005011:1.text: Mister Flower should be <style="highlight">near the fountain</style> if you're ready to see what he does.
say:13:1321005011:1.source_cn: 那么接下来，请您也去体验一下奇花的工作吧。他应该就在<...
say:13:1321005011:1.male: Mister Flower should be <style="highlight">near the fountain</style> if you're ready to see what he does.
say:13:1321005011:1.female: Mister Flower should be <style="highlight">near the fountain</style> if you're ready to see what he does.

say:14:1321005012:1.text: Let's head over now! Chippy can't wait to see what his work is like!

say:17:1321005015:1.text: I'll be brewing a good pot of tea shortly.
say:17:1321005015:1.source_cn: 茶水……我待会儿会泡一壶好茶，想请几位贵客品尝一番。

say:18:1321005016:1.text: If it's not too much trouble... would you mind bringing Mister Flower here too?
say:18:1321005016:1.source_cn: 所以，如果方便的话……还请您把奇花叫上。
say:18:1321005016:1.male: If it's not too much trouble... would you mind bringing Mister Flower here too?
say:18:1321005016:1.female: If it's not too much trouble... would you mind bringing Mister Flower here too?

say:19:1321005017:1.text: Oh? Mister Teapot, are you trying to make up with him?
say:19:1321005017:1.source_cn: 哦？茶壶先生，这是想和奇花侍者和好的意思吗？

say:20:1321005018:1.text: Ahem, I prefer to think of it as showing some noble courtesy—just like His Lordship would.
say:20:1321005018:1.source_cn: 咳……！我更愿意称之为贵族风度——就像子爵先生那样。

say:21:1321005019:1.text: Anyway, please do come back for some tea later.

choice:11:0:1.text: Do I need to try making tea, too?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我还需要体验泡茶工作吗？
choice:11:0:1.male: Do I need to try making tea, too?
choice:11:0:1.female: Do I need to try making tea, too?

say:23:1321005010:1.text: That's right. Thank you for taking the time to experience my work.
say:23:1321005010:1.source_cn: 是的。感谢您答应我的邀约，为我和奇花进行评判。
say:23:1321005010:1.male: That's right. Thank you for taking the time to experience my work.
say:23:1321005010:1.female: That's right. Thank you for taking the time to experience my work.

choice:11:1:2.text: Seems like I'm done here, right?
choice:11:1:2.male: Seems like I'm done here, right?
choice:11:1:2.female: Seems like I'm done here, right?

say:3:1321008001:1.text: Wow, thank you so much for your help. Everything is so much more organized now!
say:3:1321008001:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……有你们的帮助，这里变得有条理多了。

say:4:1321008002:1.text: You're very welcome! Chippy's glad we could help!

say:5:1321008003:1.text: Organizing the art supplies sounded simple, but it turned out to be more time-consuming than I thought.
say:5:1321008003:1.source_cn: 整理画具听上去很简单，没想到做起来居然这么费时间。

say:6:1321008004:1.text: Your work seems pretty demanding too.
say:6:1321008004:1.source_cn: 你平时的工作也很繁重呢。

say:8:1321008006:1.text: I only take care of the smaller tasks... Mister Teapot has been by His Lordship's side for years, so it's natural he handles the bigger responsibilities.
say:8:1321008006:1.source_cn: 我不像茶壶先生那样，陪伴了子爵先生很多年，所以只能做一...

say:9:1321008007:1.text: Oh, please don't say that. For an artist like Ludovic, managing art supplies is no small task. That's why he entrusted it to someone he truly trusts—you!
say:9:1321008007:1.source_cn: 别这样说。对于柳博米尔这样的艺术家而言，管理画具是一件...

say:10:1321008008:1.text: Exactly! You must be important to Ludovic if he took the time to enchant you!
say:10:1321008008:1.source_cn: 是啊，要是柳博米尔不重视你，他为什么要为你附魔呢？

say:11:1321008009:1.text: Maybe it's because... I'm an everbloom planted by His Lordship's parents and that gives me a special place in his heart...
say:11:1321008009:1.source_cn: 或许是因为……我是子爵先生父母亲手种下的永寂花，所以对...

say:12:1321008010:1.text: Or maybe, His Lordship just needed an attendant and chose me because I was there...
say:12:1321008010:1.source_cn: 又或者是，子爵先生刚好需要一个仆人，所以选中了在旁边的我……

say:13:1321008011:1.text: Uh... Let's switch the topic, shall we?
say:13:1321008011:1.source_cn: 呃，我们还是换个话题吧……

say:14:1321008012:1.text: By the way, would you like to join us for tea with Mister Teapot? He specifically asked us to invite you.
say:14:1321008012:1.source_cn: 对了，要去茶壶先生那边喝杯茶吗？他刚才特地请我们邀请你去呢！

say:15:1321008013:1.text: Mister Teapot... invited me... for tea?

say:16:1321008014:1.text: Then I must not upset him... I'll go with you.
say:16:1321008014:1.source_cn: 不能辜负他的好意……我和你们一起去。

say:3:1321009001:1.source_cn: 各位客人，请不用客气，尽情品尝这杯茶吧。

say:4:1321009002:1.text: Ahem, Mister Flower, I've specifically used the tea leaves you picked.
say:4:1321009002:1.source_cn: 奇花，这次我可是用了你采摘的茶叶。

say:5:1321009003:1.text: Oh, you mean those with petals...

say:8:1321009004:1.text: Mister Teapot, is this your way of saying sorry?
say:8:1321009004:1.source_cn: 茶壶先生，你这算是在向奇花示好吗？

say:9:1321009005:1.text: *Cough* Please, don't make fun of me.

say:10:1321009006:1.text: Please drink up before it gets cold. The flavor will fade if you wait too long.
say:10:1321009006:1.source_cn: 总之，请各位先喝一杯茶吧。否则要是放凉了，口感和香味都...

say:11:1321009007:1.text: Good point! Chippy's just getting thirsty!
say:11:1321009007:1.source_cn: 你说的有道理，那满满就不客气啦！

say:14:1321009009:1.text: Chippy, what's wrong? Spit it out already!
say:14:1321009009:1.source_cn: 满满，你先把嘴里的水吐出来吧！

say:15:1321009010:1.text: M-Magister! This tea is so bitter!
say:15:1321009010:1.male: M-Magister! This tea is so bitter!
say:15:1321009010:1.female: M-Magister! This tea is so bitter!

say:16:1321009011:1.text:
Huh? How's that possible...?
I brewed this myself, it can't possibly be bitter!
say:16:1321009011:1.source_cn: 这……这怎么可能？！\n这壶茶是我亲手泡的，怎么可能是苦的？

say:17:1321009012:1.text: Hold on, let me taste it!
say:17:1321009012:1.source_cn: 各位先别着急，等我亲自尝一尝！

say:20:1321009015:0.text: This is strange... Everything was perfect—the water temperature, each step, and the tea leaves.
say:20:1321009015:0.source_cn: 奇怪……水温正好，泡茶的每个步骤都绝对符合规范，茶叶也...

say:21:1321009016:1.text: Did I overlook something, or make a mistake...?
say:21:1321009016:1.source_cn: 难不成，是我无意间遗漏了什么，或是犯了什么错……？

say:22:1321009017:1.text: Sir <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please brew a pot of tea to help figure this out? Don't worry, I'll help guide you through it.
say:22:1321009017:1.male: Sir <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please brew a pot of tea to help figure this out? Don't worry, I'll help guide you through it.
say:22:1321009017:1.female: Miss <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please brew a pot of tea to help figure this out? Don't worry, I'll help guide you through it.

choice:13:1:2.text: Swallow the tea first, then talk.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 有必要把茶一直含在嘴里吗？
choice:13:1:2.male: Swallow the tea first, then talk.
choice:13:1:2.female: Swallow the tea first, then talk.

narration:4:1321009101:0.source_cn: 你按照茶壶先生说的步骤，重新泡了一壶茶……

say:9:1321010001:1.text: Uh-huh, you're doing exactly right. That's how tea is made!
say:9:1321010001:1.source_cn: 没错，按照这个步骤，一壶新茶就泡好了。

say:10:1321010002:1.text: But it tastes exactly the same—no fragrance, just bitterness. This is very odd!

choice_prompt:11:1321010002.source_cn: 但这壶新茶的味道和之前那壶一样，完全没有从前的清香，只有苦涩。这真是太奇怪了！

say:12:1321010003:0.text: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...
say:12:1321010003:0.source_cn: 是的，您的每个操作都非常完美。茶具也没有问题……
say:12:1321010003:0.male: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...
say:12:1321010003:0.female: Every step you took was perfect, and the teapot is fine too...

say:13:1321010004:1.text: Could it be the tea leaves?
say:13:1321010004:1.source_cn: 难道真的是茶叶出了问题……？
say:13:1321010004:1.male: Could it be the tea leaves?
say:13:1321010004:1.female: Could it be the tea leaves?

say:14:1321010005:1.text: The tea leaves I picked should be alright...
say:14:1321010005:1.source_cn: 茶叶，是我采摘的。不应该有问题……

say:15:1321010006:1.text: Especially since I used the ones that he picked just a couple of days ago... They should be fine.
say:15:1321010006:1.source_cn: 没错，尤其我今天用的还是前两天奇花刚刚采摘回来的。

say:17:1321010008:1.text: I must find out why this tea is bitter. I can't let His Lordship drink this!
say:17:1321010008:1.source_cn: 是的。所以我必须尽快找出这壶茶变苦的原因，不能让子爵先...

say:18:1321010009:1.text: Please excuse me for a moment, dear guests. I'll brew another pot with the tea His Lordship usually drinks.
say:18:1321010009:1.source_cn: 各位客人，请允许我暂时失陪一下，用平日子爵先生常喝的茶...

narration:19:1321010010:1.text: Mister Teapot brews another pot with his usual tea leaves...

say:20:1321010011:1.text: Ah, finally! No bitterness in this tea. It looks like the issue really was the tea leaves.
say:20:1321010011:1.source_cn: 唔，这次的茶终于没有苦味了，看来真的是茶叶的问题！

say:23:1321010012:1.text: But the petals and tea leaves were hand-picked by Mister Flower... How could they be bitter?
say:23:1321010012:1.source_cn: 那就奇怪了，之前那些茶叶不是奇花侍者采回来的花瓣吗？怎...

say:25:1321010014:1.text: What do you have to say now, huh?
say:25:1321010014:1.source_cn: ……奇花，你想说什么？为什么不继续说下去了？

say:26:1321010015:1.text: Now that I think about it, not only did you harvest those petals, but it was also your idea to add them to tea leaves. His Lordship even praised you for that.
say:26:1321010015:1.source_cn: 仔细想一想，不仅这些花瓣是你采回来的，再往前，用花瓣当...

say:27:1321010016:1.text: Has His Lordship's favor gone to your head? Do you think you can replace me now?
say:27:1321010016:1.source_cn: 难道是先生的恩宠宠坏了你，冲昏了你的头脑，让你以为自己...

say:28:1321010017:1.text: Wait, Mister Teapot, are you accusing Mister Flower?
say:28:1321010017:1.source_cn: ……诶？茶壶先生，你这是在指责奇花吗？

say:30:1321010019:1.text: Please forgive my rudeness. But as someone who has been with His Lordship the longest, I need to get to the bottom of this.
say:30:1321010019:1.source_cn: 抱歉，客人们，请原谅我的失礼。但作为陪伴子爵先生最久的...

say:31:1321010020:1.text: These petals and tea leaves were harvested by Mister Flower. Besides him and me, no one else had access to them, so there's no chance anyone else could've tampered with them.
say:31:1321010020:1.source_cn: 这些花瓣是奇花亲手采回来的，除了我和他以外，没有其他人...

say:32:1321010021:1.text: Mister Flower, could you explain why you always linger near the tea storage area after you return from picking leaves?
say:32:1321010021:1.source_cn: 奇花，你每次采花回来，都会在储存茶叶的橱柜附近徘徊很久...

say:34:1321010023:1.text: Were you trying to get me in trouble with His Lordship by making me mess up the tea?
say:34:1321010023:1.source_cn: 你是不是不满我对你的教导，所以想要害我犯错，被子爵先生责罚？

say:39:1321010026:1.text: Wait, Mister Flower! Don't just run away!

say:43:1321010028:1.text: Mister Teapot, you can't just accuse Mister Flower without any proof!
say:43:1321010028:1.source_cn: 茶壶先生！你太过分了，明明什么证据都没有，怎么能这样指...

say:44:1321010029:1.text: I-I didn't expect him to run off. I just wanted to figure out what happened...
say:44:1321010029:1.source_cn: 我……我没想到奇花会直接跑开。我只是想问清楚究竟是怎么...

choice_prompt:45:1321010029.text: I-I didn't expect him to run off. I just wanted to figure out what happened...
choice_prompt:45:1321010029.source_cn: 我……我没想到奇花会直接跑开。我只是想问清楚究竟是怎么回事……

say:46:1321010030:1.text: Magister is right! Let's find Mister Flower first!
say:46:1321010030:1.source_cn: 对对对，我们先把奇花追回来吧！
say:46:1321010030:1.male: Magister is right! Let's find Mister Flower first!
say:46:1321010030:1.female: Magister is right! Let's find Mister Flower first!

choice:45:0:1.text: We need to go after him quickly!
choice:45:0:1.male: We need to go after him quickly!
choice:45:0:1.female: We need to go after him quickly!

choice:11:0:1.text: The issue isn't with the steps.
choice:11:0:1.male: The issue isn't with the steps.
choice:11:0:1.female: The issue isn't with the steps.

choice:11:1:2.text: Could it be the tea leaves?
choice:11:1:2.male: Could it be the tea leaves?
choice:11:1:2.female: Could it be the tea leaves?

narration:49:1321009101:0.text: You follow Mister Teapot's steps and brew a fresh pot of tea...
narration:49:1321009101:0.source_cn: 你按照茶壶先生说的步骤，重新泡了一壶茶……

say:0:1321011001:0.text: Oh no, he's gone outside the manor!
say:0:1321011001:0.source_cn: 不好了，奇花跑出永寂庄园了！

say:0:1321012001:0.text: He won't run off too far.
say:0:1321012001:0.source_cn: 奇花胆子小，不会走得太远。

say:0:1321013001:0.text: There he is! Some monsters are trying to hurt him! We have to protect him!
say:0:1321013001:0.source_cn: 奇花在那边！有……有怪物想伤害他！我们得保护他！

say:4:1321014002:1.text: I-I'm fine... I'm so sorry for making everyone worry...
say:4:1321014002:1.source_cn: 没、没事……对不起，让各位担心了……

say:5:1321014003:1.text: Phew, I'm just glad you're safe...

say:6:1321014004:1.text: It seems like Mister Teapot really cares about you! He was the fastest to run here!
say:6:1321014004:1.source_cn: 这么看来，茶壶先生还是很关心奇花的嘛！我们一路上追过来...

say:9:1321014005:1.text: Yeah, Mister Teapot was so fast, his face turned bright red. It's like he was boiling with concern!
say:9:1321014005:1.source_cn: 是啊，茶壶先生跑得脸都红了，好像连脑袋里的茶都重新热起...

say:11:1321014007:1.text: *Sigh* Why are you thanking me? I should be the one apologizing.
say:11:1321014007:1.source_cn: 唉，你谢我做什么……应该我向你道歉才对。

say:12:1321014008:1.text: I shouldn't have been so mean to you earlier. After all, preserving the tea leaves is my job, and if they turned bitter, it's on me.
say:12:1321014008:1.source_cn: 对不起，刚才我不该那样训斥你。毕竟保存茶叶是我的职责，...

say:13:1321014009:1.source_cn: 不是的，茶壶先生……那不是你的错。

say:14:1321014010:1.text: I just remembered... I never got around to honey-preserving the petals I picked a few days ago.
say:14:1321014010:1.source_cn: 我刚刚才想起来，前几天新摘的那些花瓣，还没来得及蜜渍……

say:16:1321014012:1.text: That's right. Only honey-preserved petals can be used for tea... Honey locks in the fragrance and removes the bitterness.
say:16:1321014012:1.source_cn: 是的。只有经过蜜渍的花瓣才能作为茶叶……既能保留花香，...

say:17:1321014013:1.text: I... I just remembered... Sorry, it's all my fault...
say:17:1321014013:1.source_cn: 我、我刚刚才想起来……对不起，都是我的错……

say:20:1321014014:1.text: That explains everything! No wonder the tea tasted so bitter!
say:20:1321014014:1.source_cn: 原来是这样！难怪前两壶茶喝起来会是苦的！

say:21:1321014015:1.text: But I've never done anything like that before! Why didn't the previous batches of tea taste bitter?
say:21:1321014015:1.source_cn: 可是，我从没做过这样的事！为什么以前的花瓣茶叶没有苦味？

say:22:1321014016:1.text: That's because every time I picked the petals, I would soak them in honey right away and store them with tea leaves by the next morning.
say:22:1321014016:1.source_cn: 我……每次采回花瓣之后，都会将它们浸泡起来，第二天早上...

say:23:1321014017:1.text: But a few days ago, when I returned to the manor, His Lordship asked me to find some missing paint. After that, I completely forgot about the petals...
say:23:1321014017:1.source_cn: 但是前几天，我刚回到庄园，子爵先生就说有一支颜料不见了...

say:24:1321014018:1.text: So, this is why I always see you hanging around the tea storage area?

say:25:1321014019:1.text: Yes, and this is the first time I forgot. I'm sorry, Mister Teapot...
say:25:1321014019:1.source_cn: 嗯，我只忘过这一次！抱歉，茶壶先生……

say:28:1321014020:1.text: It seems Mister Flower has been doing a lot more work behind the scenes than we realized.
say:28:1321014020:1.source_cn: 看来奇花默默做了很多工作呢。

say:29:1321014021:1.text: I finally understand why His Lordship chose you.
say:29:1321014021:1.source_cn: 难怪……我终于理解子爵先生为什么会选中你了。

say:30:1321014022:1.text: What do you mean by that...?

say:31:1321014023:1.text: What I mean is, you're not completely without merit.
say:31:1321014023:1.source_cn: 我的意思是——咳，你也不是完全没有可取之处。

choice_prompt:32:1321014023.text: What I mean is, you're not completely without merit.
choice_prompt:32:1321014023.source_cn: 我的意思是——咳，你也不是完全没有可取之处。

say:34:1321014026:1.text: It's dangerous to be out here. We should head back to the manor right away. Let me check the time...
say:34:1321014026:1.source_cn: 庄园外并不安全，我们还是尽快返回吧。让我看看时间……

say:35:1321014027:1.text: Oh my, it's already tea time! Mister Flower, this is your chance to shine.
say:35:1321014027:1.source_cn: 哎呀，已经到下午茶时间了。奇花，现在是你体现价值的时候了。

say:36:1321014028:1.text: Y-you want me to prepare the afternoon tea?

say:37:1321014029:1.text: And don't forget to honey-preserve those bitter petals.
say:37:1321014029:1.source_cn: 还要记得把苦涩的花瓣拿去蜜渍。

say:38:1321014030:1.text: Of course... thank you, Mister Teapot!

choice:32:0:1.text: It means he's realized his mistake.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 意思是他认识到了自己的错误
choice:32:0:1.male: It means he's realized his mistake.
choice:32:0:1.female: It means he's realized his mistake.

say:40:1321014025:1.text: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.
say:40:1321014025:1.source_cn: 或许是吧。但是对待子爵先生和尊贵的客人，我一直都很有风度。
say:40:1321014025:1.male: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.
say:40:1321014025:1.female: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.

choice:32:1:2.text: Have you always been this mean?
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 你一向说话都是这个风格吗？
choice:32:1:2.male: Have you always been this mean?
choice:32:1:2.female: Have you always been this mean?

say:0:1321015001:0.text: Hmm... Their relationship seems very complicated. I can't tell whether they get along well or not...
say:0:1321015001:0.source_cn: 茶壶先生和奇花侍者的关系，到底算好还是不好呢……
